job.job_title: Hiring Senior Data Engineer -Python / ETL / SQL Server For MNC
job.job_description:
Python Data Engineer-




Job Location- Pune, Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Trivandrum




Important :


Notice period : Immediate to 15-30 days Max ONLY (Immediate Joiners preferred)



Please note - There should not be Career Gap more than 6 months




Important: Pure python backend/web developer profiles will not be suitable for this role




Strong Python Data Engineer with atleast 5+ years hands-on experience on Python-based data processing frameworks, combined with strong ETL (preferably SQL Server) capabilities to design and manage end-to-end data pipelines.
Design and develop scalable data pipelines using Python frameworks
Implement ETL/ELT processes for data ingestion, transformation, and loading
Write and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures
Excellent grip on debugging and problem solving techniques
Work closely with stakeholders to understand data requirements and workflows
Ensure data quality, performance optimization, and reliability
Monitor and support batch data pipelines and production jobs
Ability to work in team in diverse/multiple stakeholder environment and collaborate with upstream/downstream functional teams to identify, troubleshoot and resolve data issues.
Strong problem solving and Good Analytical skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Experience and desire to work in a Global delivery environment. • Stay up to date with new technologies and industry trends in Development.
